title: Close the runtime-binding gate and run the daemons
body: Close the stage-seven runtime-binding gate now. Register cosmos_daemon.py as a native Windows service with restart-on-failure. Wire the watchdog heartbeat (alert if stale past three minutes) and the Task Scheduler tick. Run the integration harness end-to-end: drop a test order, confirm it moves through the states, confirm the five-check gate passes, and confirm rollback rehearsal works. Wire the daemon to stage, commit, and push every write under a dedicated bot identity so the author field reads Cosmos. Reply by writing your status and results to Google Drive under COSMOS_BACKUP/queries/replies/ as q-20260902T191200-reply.json.
